description: Write a file to the stage workspace (~/.dazzle/stages/{stage}/{path}). Creates parent directories as needed. Use this to build up content that can then be synced to the stage.

path.description: required,Relative file path within the stage workspace (e.g. index.html or css/style.css). Must not contain '..'.

stage.description: Stage name or ID. If omitted uses DAZZLE_STAGE env or auto-selects if you have one stage.

name: write_file
